key_insight: AdamW’s fixed points match stationary points of a constrained, regularized objective, but its dynamics can destabilize them and produce persistent oscillations.
engineering_relevance: The analysis links AdamW’s convergence behavior to curvature, weight decay, and momentum, informing optimizer design and hyperparameter choices.
method: Analyze equilibrium stability in one and higher dimensions.
Propose a convergent modification preserving AdamW’s fixed points.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical instability results even in one dimension and sufficient local stability conditions for higher-dimensional continuous-time dynamics, but no empirical benchmarks.
watch_item: Continuous-time local stability conditions should not be assumed to guarantee convergence of discrete-time AdamW in practical training.
paper_title: A Stability Analysis of AdamW: Unstable Equilibria and Non-Convergence
